SELECT 'artifact' AS node_kind, consumer_id::text AS identity FROM revision_links WHERE project_id=%(project)s AND input_id=ANY(CAST(%(artifacts)s AS uuid[])) UNION SELECT 'artifact', subject_id::text FROM revalidation_privacy_links WHERE project_id=%(project)s AND input_id=ANY(CAST(%(artifacts)s AS uuid[])) UNION SELECT 'runtime', record_id::text FROM runtime_artifact_refs WHERE project_id=%(project)s AND revision_id=ANY(CAST(%(artifacts)s AS uuid[])) UNION SELECT 'runtime', record_id::text FROM runtime_runtime_refs WHERE project_id=%(project)s AND target_record_id=ANY(CAST(%(runtimes)s AS uuid[])) UNION SELECT 'artifact', revision_id::text FROM runtime_links WHERE project_id=%(project)s AND record_id=ANY(CAST(%(runtimes)s AS uuid[])) UNION SELECT 'blob', sha256 FROM runtime_blob_refs WHERE project_id=%(project)s AND record_id=ANY(CAST(%(runtimes)s AS uuid[])) UNION SELECT 'blob', b.sha256 FROM artifact_blobs AS a JOIN blobs AS b USING(project_id,storage_key) WHERE a.project_id=%(project)s AND a.revision_id=ANY(CAST(%(artifacts)s AS uuid[])) UNION SELECT 'blob', asset.value->'blob_ref'->>'sha256' FROM catalog_publications AS p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.config->'published_assets') AS asset WHERE p.project_id=%(project)s AND p.revision_id=ANY(CAST(%(artifacts)s AS uuid[])) UNION SELECT 'runtime', record_id::text FROM runtime_blob_refs WHERE project_id=%(project)s AND sha256=ANY(CAST(%(hashes)s AS text[])) UNION SELECT 'artifact', a.revision_id::text FROM blobs AS b JOIN artifact_blobs AS a USING(project_id,storage_key) WHERE b.project_id=%(project)s AND b.sha256=ANY(CAST(%(hashes)s AS text[])) UNION SELECT 'artifact', p.revision_id::text FROM unnest(CAST(%(hashes)s AS text[])) AS marked(sha256) JOIN catalog_publications AS p ON p.project_id=%(project)s AND p.config->'published_assets' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('blob_ref',jsonb_build_object('sha256',marked.sha256)))
